issues.jp_before: 週末[しゅうまつ]、友達[ともだち]{と|to-with}朝[あさ]十時[じゅうじ]{ごろ/くらい|goro-time}公園[こうえん]{で|de-place}会[あ]う予定[よてい]です。

issues.jp_before: 先週[せんしゅう]{の|no-possessive}金曜日[きんようび]{の|no-possessive}夜[よる]十時[じゅうじ]{ごろ/くらい|goro-time}、友達[ともだち]{から|kara-from}メール{が|ga-subject}来[き]ました。

issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]{なんか/など|nanka-nante}{が|ga-subject}先生[せんせい]{に|ni-change}なれる{でしょうか|ka-question}。
issues.problem: The ka-question slot contained でしょうか, which is not a particle; the English had an awkward '(a nobody)'; lv 4 was too low for なんか.
issues.action: Slot changed to でしょう{か|ka-question}, English cleaned up, lv changed to 3.

issues.jp_before: 会議[かいぎ]{なんか/など|nanka-nante}{に|ni-target}出[で]る時間[じかん]{は|wa-topic}ありません。
issues.problem: lv 4 was too low for belittling なんか.

issues.jp_before: 田中[たなか]さん{が|ga-subject}遅刻[ちこく]する{なんて|nanka-nante}、珍[めずら]しいです{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: Distractor など after a clause (遅刻するなど、珍しい) is a formal or written version of the same なんて and is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced など with さえ (ungrammatical after a plain clause); the English was also tidied.

issues.jp_before: 部長[ぶちょう]{が|ga-subject}私[わたし]{の|no-possessive}案[あん]{を|o-object}ほめてくれる{なんて|nanka-nante}、夢[ゆめ]みたいです。
issues.problem: Distractor など is a formal version of the same なんて; the 夢みたい ending duplicated an existing item in nanka-nante.jsonl; the English was in the past tense but the Japanese was not.
issues.action: Changed to ほめてくれた{なんて}、本当にうれしいです; replaced など with さえ; updated the English.
